messages.body_plain:
Date: Wednesday, December 3
Time: 5pm (pending room availability)
Location: MIIS (pending)
Topic: shiny and googleVis

Dave Roush has volunteered to talk through his use of shiny <http://shiny.rstudio.com/> and googleVis <https://github.com/mages/googleVis> in visualization of some of his projects. If he can add in ggvis <http://ggvis.rstudio.com/> it might be even awesome-r …

I’ll update this announcement when things stabilize.

-bill

messages.subject: TOPICS
messages.body_plain:
Let’s start talking about Topics. Please reply with one of three types of posts:
Topics that you would like to see. If we have plenty of “simpler” topics, perhaps we can have a “catch-all” meeting where several things are presented/discussed.
Perhaps a Reply to a topic request if you can take it on or contribute as a team approach. If a topic starts to garner more conversation, we may spin it off into its own discussion.
Topics that you volunteer to present. This might be as little as a micro-topic (see above), a full-fledged meeting topic, or perhaps a multi-part series (yippee!).

Periodically, we’ll either flush this discussion or start a new one.
​
